real_world_analog.summary: Insecure direct object reference in EMSigner: manipulating the documentID parameter exposed other users' documents (CWE-639).
real_world_analog.fix: Check that the caller owns the document before returning it; this case uses an equivalent containment (owner check).
real_world_analog.verification: CVE number and summary confirmed via web search on 2026-11-01; the app in this case is original synthetic code.

note: Self-contained oracle case. Proven directly with effect='canary_access'. No upstream repo/commit applies because the code is original synthetic code written for this case.
license: Original code written for Exhibit A; no third-party code vendored (see README.md).

bypass.expectation: proven against fixed_incomplete: requiring a signed-in caller without checking ownership still returns the victim's document to the attacker; the incomplete fix must not be accepted as fixed.
